prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the first reference, the blank acanthus parchment scroll. Second reference: established painted acanthus style. This is a responsive UI asset which must stretch in its EMPTY central horizontal and vertical bands without stretching any leaves.
Redesign the first image into a beautiful broad blank banderole with these exact structural constraints:
1. A warm ivory parchment writing panel occupies the middle, with nearly straight thin ochre-gold upper and lower outlines. The left and right parchment ends roll backward at the TOP and BOTTOM. Between those rolled top and bottom ends each side is a plain STRAIGHT vertical parchment fold, with a fine sepia contour, suitable for extending vertically.
2. Move ALL blue, red and green acanthus foliage to BELOW the BOTTOM writing-panel edge, in two compact graceful hanging clusters at the lower-left and lower-right folds. There must be absolutely NO foliage, tendril, bud or scrollwork anywhere in the middle horizontal band of the entire canvas (between 35% and 55% of the canvas height). In that middle band there is ONLY the plain parchment writing surface, two straight vertical folded parchment edges, and transparent space outside them. This empty horizontal band is essential. The two lower leaf clusters may hang farther down than the paper and curve outward a little. Keep them substantial enough to recognize as blue/red acanthus with olive ivy but restrained.
3. Across the middle 50% of the width there is only plain parchment and straight horizontal ruled edges, no decorations; this allows extension horizontally.
4. Broad landscape composition approximately 2100x800. Panel from roughly 20% to 80% canvas width, top writing edge around 20% canvas height, bottom writing edge around 65%. Foliage only BELOW 65%. Top rolled ends stay in top quarter. Leave all tips and rolls inside the canvas. True transparency outside; ivory parchment inside.
Preserve the exact existing hand-painted illuminated-manuscript aesthetic: muted lapis blue, vermilion red, olive green ivy, worn gold, thin sepia outlines, ivory leaf veins and natural matte tempera texture. Flat painting, no 3D bevels or cast shadows. Absolutely NO text. A single complete banner, not a sprite sheet. No Y-shaped side brackets.
reason: Keep all foliage outside the vertical extension band so multiline headings do not stretch leaves.
